Please read the files in papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/02_localized_zero_correlations and begin research outlined in the research overview. 

Track your progress in the research progress folder, write research notes in the notes folder, and record chat history in the chat-histories folder. Please provide guidance for the continuation at the end of your research, and a continuation note for model changes.
I’ll read the investigation and repository workflow, then start the first open research problem and save the results, progress, and continuation notes in the requested folders.

The branch is still at its setup stage. Its first task is to compare two candidates: a pair statistic that retains each zero’s distance from the real axis, and a functional of the full local zero configuration. I’ll test both against the available source estimates, including their time ranges and whether their errors could resolve a single exceptional pair.

The quadratic pair statistic simplifies exactly under conjugation symmetry: it becomes a nonnegative weighting of the one-point transverse second moment already studied in the parent investigation. For a constant separation weight, the identity is simply \(S=2NQ\). This preserves the single-pair signal, but it does not yet provide a stronger estimate.

I also confirmed that the cited growing-order heat-density theorem works at negative Newman time and excludes time zero. Applying it here would need both a justified extension of its time range and an error bound for the nonlinear zero statistic.

There is a useful way to handle the logarithmic singularities. A nonzero value on the safe line, together with a bound on a surrounding disk, gives an explicit estimate for the area where the field is very small. That can convert a uniform field approximation into an error bound for the localized zero moment without dividing by the field near its zeros.

I’m developing this comparison at Newman time zero. It would make the approximation error controllable; the separate task of proving the approximate moment is small would remain open.

The comparison now has an explicit form: a disk error \(\delta\) gives a local logarithm error bounded by \(C_X(\delta/M_X)^{2/(n_X+2)}\), where \(n_X=O(\log X)\). The bound allows multiple zeros and does not require a lower bound on every contour around them.

I’m checking the constants and paying the theta-source truncation errors. The result should give a rigorous way to approximate the observable, while leaving its signed upper bound as a separate open problem.

The derivations are saved, and the proof-author check found no correction to the comparison. The two results are the exact reduction of the proposed pair statistic and an explicit time-zero approximation bound that remains valid through multiple zeros.

I’m finishing the progress register, checking file links and source hashes, and preparing the Sol assessment packet. The notes distinguish the proved approximation bound from the still-open signed estimate needed to exclude a nonreal pair.

The file checks passed: all 170 local links resolve, both input manifests match, and every branch file is below the size limit. Another chat has also been updating the neighboring Green branch. I’ve left those edits alone and am checking its new summary for any result that should be mentioned in this handoff.

Completed the opening research round and saved two results:

- [Pair/configuration reduction](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/02_localized_zero_correlations/notes/01_TND_OC_REFLECTION_AND_CONFIGURATION_REDUCTION_20261107.md): the proposed quadratic pair statistic reduces to a weighted transverse second moment.
- [Time-zero approximation theorem](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/02_localized_zero_correlations/notes/02_TND_OC_LOCAL_LOG_TRANSFER_20261107.md): explicit error bounds transfer complete-source approximations to localized zero statistics, including multiple zeros.

These have written proofs and a same-author check. **The signed upper bound needed to exclude a nonreal pair remains unproved.**

The [progress register](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/02_localized_zero_correlations/research-progress/01_TND_OC_RESEARCH_PROGRESS_20261107.md) is updated, chat history refreshed, and final-response capture queued.

**Next: [E] TND-OC-E02 — Sol6.1/ultra**, for separate assessment. The [continuation and model-change note](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-5/08_theta_observables_newman_dynamics/03_operator_imaginary_time_evolution/02_localized_zero_correlations/continuation-notes/02_TND_OC_AFTER_OPENING_RESEARCH_20261107.md) contains the exact packet and a pasteable prompt.
